#Dogecoin  ETF speculation and how it’s influencing the market
Traders are pricing in ~80% odds of a Dogecoin spot ETF being approved by September 2025, according to prediction markets like Polymarket
DOGE ETF approval driving meme-coin legitimization

Dogecoin (#DOGE)  is currently trading around $0.262, down slightly (~−0.03%) from yesterday’s close .

Earlier this week, DOGE briefly surged toward $0.29, its highest level in 10+ months, before pulling back amid profit-taking and overbought technical conditions
Dogecoin (#DOGE) could test $0.20–$0.23 in the short term, possibly reaching $0.60–$0.70 later this year, powered by meme-cycle enthusiasm and ETF optimism
